Description.DetailedDescription: Tactile Switch SPST-NO Top Actuated Surface Mount

Category.Name: Switches
Category.SeoDescription: Switches are devices used to interrupt the flow of electrical current in one or more circuits, under the direct physical control of some outside mechanism such as a user's finger or thumb, a magnet, or a moving machine component. Organization of sub-groups within the category occurs along lines of the physical style or form of switches' actuators, or a particular application or purpose for which they are designed.

ChildCategories.Name: Tactile Switches
ChildCategories.SeoDescription: Tactile Switches are an electromechanical device used to start or stop current flow along a circuit. Devices in this family are often very small and are turned on or off through the use of an actuator that is depressed into the unit’s body. These devices also provide feedback to the user through an audible click and/or a change in pressure upon reaching the trigger point. The operating force ranges from 50gf to 970gf.
